value.rationale: A motivated natural complete classification of the full Aut(A) element-orbit-size invariant on an entire length-four split local Hilbert stratum, with exact characteristic and discriminant branches. The full spectra uncover that distinct Gorenstein and non-Gorenstein algebras in characteristic two have indistinguishable element-orbit-size spectra. It is neither an arbitrary slice nor a mere recounting of known isomorphism classes.
